name: gajendra
description: Gajendra: one clear focus across your AI tools.

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:server
scripts.build:ui: cross-env GAJENDRA_ENTRY=gajendra.html vite build && node scripts/normalize-build.mjs dist/gajendra.html
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js='import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' && node scripts/normalize-build.mjs dist/server.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
